description: This file defines a template class Layout for managing memory layout of arrays with dynamic sizes, including alignment and offset calculations, primarily used for low-level memory management and serialization within the Abseil library.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::Layout
classes.description: Template class for defining memory layouts of multiple arrays with dynamic sizes, providing methods for offset, size, pointer, and slice calculations, as well as layout debugging.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::LayoutImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation class that handles the core logic of memory layout calculations, including offsets, alignments, and size computations.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::Aligned
classes.description: Type wrapper to specify custom alignment for array elements within the layout.

methods.name: Layout::Partial
methods.description: Static method to create a partial layout with specified sizes for a subset of arrays.

methods.name: Layout::AllocSize
methods.description: Returns the total size in bytes needed for the layout.

methods.name: Layout::Pointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of a specific array within the layout.

methods.name: Layout::Slices
methods.description: Returns tuple of spans for all arrays with known sizes.

methods.name: Layout::DebugString
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing the memory layout.
